text:
lisa_cinderlane: Hey team — Cinderlane here. We want to onboard a contract summarizer for our merchant agreements. Requirements: PHI/PII redaction, HSM-backed keys, VPC-only data, low latency (p95 <= 250ms). Model baseline is a 12B open model; we'd like quantized 4-bit to hit cost targets. What do you need from us to start and which deployment (Dedicated vs Private) makes more sense?

maria_cs: welcome! we can support this. short answers: Private if you need full network isolation + HSM in your VPC; Dedicated if tenant isolation + predictable capacity is enough and you can accept managed networking. quick q: do you require air-gapped/on-prem?

lisa_cinderlane: not air-gapped, but strict VPC-only. we'll need audit logs but want request-body logging disabled. DPA and SOC2 required.

sam_se: re: latency — 12B q4 on modern infra should hit p95 250ms for single-shot if batch=1 and sequence len small. streaming will add complexity. do you have typical prompt/response lengths?

lisa_cinderlane: avg prompt 120 tokens, response ~220 tokens. mostly single-turn. no streaming needed.

dmitri_ml: for onboarding we'll need three eval suites from you: 1) gold-quality/regression (200 labeled examples), 2) safety/redaction tests (edge PHI cases, 100 examples), 3) stress/latency traces (synthetic traffic). also ask you to flag core failure modes.

ana_privsec: +1 on data artifacts. for HSM integration we need key policies, certs, and your KMS vendor. if you want us to plug into your HSM, we'll provide integration checklist and support. note: Private deployment allows request-body scrubbing on collection side.

lisa_cinderlane: can share sample sets by end of week. KMS is AWS KMS w/ external key manager; will send contacts.

deploy-bot: Onboarding checklist created: /onboard/2026-06/cinderlane-contract-sentry — owners: maria_cs, sam_se, dmitri_ml, ana_privsec.

maria_cs: scheduled enablement call Thu 10am PT — invite sent to lisa and procurement. agenda: data exchange, eval pass criteria, rollout plan, pilot length, SLA items.

sam_se: note on cost — Dedicated reserved pool gives predictable pricing. we'll produce pilot quote vs Private setup/infra estimate.

dmitri_ml: example eval command we usually run for initial baseline:
```bash
python eval_runner.py --model contract-sentry-12b-q4 --input samples.json --metrics rouge-l,redaction_rate,hallucination_score --batch 1
```

lisa_cinderlane: one more procurement note — they want a 6-month pilot with clear success metrics for renewal. can we lock sample SLOs and incident allowances for pilot?

maria_cs: yes, pilot -> renewal cadence is standard. we'll document success criteria (accuracy thresholds, redaction pass rate, latency p95) in the onboarding doc and feed into the quote. i'll capture action items after call.

ana_privsec: i'll DM you HSM integration doc and required artifacts list. also will list what we can mask/avoid logging in Private deployment.

maria_cs: next steps checklist: 1) Cinderlane to share labeled samples + PHI test set by EOW, 2) sign DPA, 3) enablement call Thu 10am PT, 4) Redwood to produce pilot quote & baseline eval within 5 business days after samples. owner: @sam_se. :thumbsup:

lisa_cinderlane: perfect — thanks all, see you on Thu.
